ValidationRule.description: Validate if at-least one type of valid contact detail is mentioned.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, NOT(CONTAINS( $User.Username,'unica.integration@anzx.com')), RecordType.DeveloperName = 'CCRM_Lead', ISBLANK( Email ) , ISBLANK( MobilePhone ) , ISBLANK( Home_Phone__c ) , ISBLANK( Work_Phone__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: At least one type of Contact method is required.
